conventions.class: Inputs marked ILLUSTRATIVE or HYPOTHETICAL are class C.
conventions.exact_arithmetic: bucket state uses exact fractions, printed as decimals

equations.refill: n ← min(B, n + r × (t − t0)); t0 ← t
equations.admit: if n ≥ c: n ← n − c, admit; else reject with 429
equations.window_bound: over any window of length T, at most B + r × T units pass

bound.note: Only whole tokens admit a request, so the count is the floor of the bound.

gpu_protection.formula: requests rejected at the gateway × mean prompt tokens
gpu_protection.note: Prefill work that never reaches an inference queue or takes KV blocks. HYPOTHETICAL mean prompt size.

fixed_window.note: INCR + EXPIRE counts reset at the window boundary, so both batches pass.

plan.label: HYPOTHETICAL plan limits (one plan for both tenants)

rpm_vs_tpm.model: M-dense prefill on H-teach (H100 SXM, BF16 dense peak × hypothetical prefill_mfu); no prefix-cache reuse; decode cost not included

admitted_rpm_with_rpm_and_tpm.formula: min(requests/min, floor(TPM limit / tokens per request))

prefill_flops_per_request.formula: 2 × N_matmul × T + 2 × H × d_head × L × T × (T + 1)

prefill_gpu_seconds_per_min.formula: requests/min × prefill FLOPs / (H100 BF16 dense × prefill_mfu)

admitted_rpm_with_rpm_and_tpm.formula: min(requests/min, floor(TPM limit / tokens per request))

prefill_flops_per_request.formula: 2 × N_matmul × T + 2 × H × d_head × L × T × (T + 1)

prefill_gpu_seconds_per_min.formula: requests/min × prefill FLOPs / (H100 BF16 dense × prefill_mfu)

arrivals.label: at_t0 HYPOTHETICAL (hypothetical.backend.burst_requests); the trickle is ILLUSTRATIVE; rejected requests are not retried

reserve_then_refund.rule: admit if bucket ≥ prompt + max_tokens; take that; give back max_tokens − output at completion

context_tokens_in_flight_bound.note: Reservations admitted within one stream duration D fit in B + r × D, and each covers prompt + max_tokens.

count_as_produced.rule: admit if bucket ≥ prompt; take prompt; take each output token in the second it is produced

context_tokens_in_flight_bound.note: Admission takes only the prompt, but each request can grow to max_tokens.

count_as_produced.context_tokens_in_flight_bound_note: the limiter guarantees it, but it is larger by the ratio (prompt + max_tokens) / prompt

charge_at_completion.rule: admit if bucket > 0; take prompt + output when the response completes
charge_at_completion.context_tokens_in_flight_bound_note: no bound from the limiter: every request is admitted while the bucket is positive

public_examples.reserve_then_refund: OpenAI's rate-limit guide: the limit counts the maximum of max_tokens and an estimate (SRC-164)
public_examples.count_as_produced: Anthropic's rate-limit docs: output-token limits count tokens as they are produced; max_tokens does not count (SRC-163)
public_examples.charge_at_completion: Agent Router (formerly Envoy AI Gateway): usage is charged after the response completes; an admitted stream is not cut (SRC-302)

inputs.label: gateway_pods, tenant_rpm_limit, clock_skew_s HYPOTHETICAL; tenant_rate_per_s and pods_carrying_traffic ILLUSTRATIVE

admitted_rate.formula: min(tenant rate, pods carrying traffic × per-pod rate)

local_buckets.note: The tenant is under its limit, but long-lived HTTP/2 connections put all its requests on a few pods.

central_bucket.cost: one round trip to the shared store per check

script_calls_per_request.note: Minimum: a request without tool calls has one inference pass.

script_calls_fleet.formula: peak arrival rate × calls per request
script_calls_fleet.note: A lower bound: every extra inference pass adds two calls.

clock_skew_error.note: Extra or missing refill per update if each gateway used its own clock.
